components.css: .ds-work{color:var(--foreground,#1c1917);font-family:ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-work header{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}.ds-work header strong{font-size:.875rem;font-weight:680}.ds-work header small{color:var(--muted-foreground,#6b6762);font-size:.78rem}.ds-work-strip{display:flex;height:9px;margin:28px 0 20px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:999px;background:var(--muted,#f5f4f2)}.ds-work-strip i:nth-child(1){width:68%}.ds-work-strip i:nth-child(2){width:16%}.ds-work-strip i:nth-child(3){width:12%}.ds-work-strip i:nth-child(4){width:4%}.ds-work dl{margin:0}.ds-work dl>div{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border,#dedbd7)}.ds-work dt{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;color:var(--muted-foreground,#6b6762);font-size:.76rem}.ds-work dd{margin:0;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:680;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-work-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:2px}.ds-work-complete{background:var(--primary,#292524)}.ds-work-active{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary,#292524) 56%,var(--background,#fff))}.ds-work-unstarted{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--muted-foreground,#6b6762) 46%,var(--background,#fff))}.ds-work-blocked{background:color-mix(in srgb,#d92d20 76%,var(--foreground,#1c1917))}

narrative.overview:
Northstar Pulse is a host-native project instrument: compact, calm, and exact. It reads as one continuous ruled report rather than a collection of interchangeable dashboard cards. The Pulse Register structure, identified by seed 8d1308b2, establishes a deliberate scan path from status to four headline measures, across a dominant seven-day activity line, and into the adjacent work breakdown.

The system inherits the Lunaris theme and lets typography, tabular figures, and hairline rules carry the hierarchy. Synthetic-data language remains visible, status never relies on color alone, and the narrow layout preserves the same reading order by stacking instead of simplifying away information. A data-derived pulse note and double-ring weekly high add useful personality, while the line traces once like an instrument completing its reading.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous ruled report with no floating cards
Compact tabular measures and adjacent work breakdown
Data-derived status note and weekly-high annotation
Host-native theming with a narrow responsive stack

rules.name: The Signal Color Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red communicate project state only; they never provide generic emphasis or decoration.

rules.name: The Host Theme Rule
rules.body: Canvas, ink, muted copy, rules, surfaces, and primary marks inherit Lunaris variables with explicit fallbacks.

rules.name: The Tabular Scan Rule
rules.body: Timestamps, metric values, chart annotations, and work counts use tabular numerals so columns remain visually stable.

rules.name: The Flat Register Rule
rules.body: Keep every region on one host canvas; use rules and spacing for structure, never elevation effects.

dos: Do keep the complete pulse visible in one ordinary desktop viewport.
Do preserve the status → metrics → seven-day activity → work-breakdown reading order at every width.
Do pair every semantic color with explicit status or category text.
Do keep “Generated sample” and the reporting period visible in the header.
Do preserve accessible SVG naming, visible point values, reduced-motion behavior, and theme-aware contrast.
donts: Don't add editing controls, filters, tabs, settings, or navigation to this read-only report.
Don't replace the continuous register with equal-sized cards or bento panels.
Don't add gradients, glass, shadows, illustrations, or decorative chart effects.
Don't use green, amber, or red for generic emphasis.
Don't remove data or labels from the narrow layout; stack or scroll the existing report instead.
